R0239.title: Affiliate Marketing Commission Fraud
R0239.definition: Channels use cookie stuffing, fake traffic, or landing-page hijacking to obtain commissions improperly.
R0239.description:
Affiliate marketing commission fraud uses cookie stuffing, fake traffic, landing page hijacking, coupon plugins, or last-click hijacking to attribute orders to a cheating partner.

Brands then pay commission for organic orders or other channels results. Controls need real referral path validation, click quality checks, conversion windows, and attribution conflict analysis.
R0239.influence: Commission fraud inflates partner spend, corrupts attribution reports, and reduces returns for legitimate partners.
